import numpy as np, itertools, os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
nm='Demo pair 1'
a=np.array(G[nm+' input']); b=np.array(G[nm+' output'])
H,W=a.shape
P=list(map(int,a[0]))
L=min(w for w in range(1,W) if all(P[i]==P[i%w] for i in range(W)))
print('P',P,'L',L)
for r in range(H):
    inc=[c for c in range(W) if a[r,c]==0 and P[c]!=0]
    onc=[c for c in range(W) if b[r,c]==0 and P[c]!=0]
    print(r,'in ',inc,'out',onc)
